notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Per request, added a setting to Invert the Y axis for your camera
[*] Also per request, added settings to remap controls
[/list]
[h1]Reworks / Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]Cerapter Nerfs[/h3]

[i]After reviewing more feedback, I have concluded that the electrified steed is still too bothersome for a lot of players. These changes should hopefully give the player a bit more leeway while still retaining the superboss difficulty.[/i]

[list]
[*] Increased attack cooldown from 2.75 to 3 seconds
[*] Decreased melee damage from 30 to 25
[*] Decreased homing missile damage from 30 to 25
[*] Decreased lightning arrow damage from 40 to 30
[*] Laserbeam now takes 1.25 seconds to charge up instead of 1
[/list]

[h3]Other Reworks[/h3]

[list]
[*] When watching some playthroughs, I noticed it isn't intuitive to Blink through enemies, which is your main source of defense in the early game. I added the following hint during the first fight: "Blink through enemies..."
[*] Changed the initial attack delay of the Achroma Soldier guarding the sword from 0 to 0.75 seconds, to give the player a bit of time to react.
[*] Golden jump pad after the penultimate boss now triggers when touching it, rather than needing to interact with it
[/list]

- Solomon

notes.title: 1.0.1.7 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Per request, the game is now optimized for 21:9 monitors (and other ultrawide monitors, though primarily tested with 21:9) to use the full width of the monitor without the black borders
[*] Fixed the issue introduced in the previous patch where jump pads in Entropa's Garden shoot you too far
[/list]
[h1]Drumroll please...[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the interval between the Achroma Cerapter's attacks from 2.5 seconds to 2.75 seconds
[*] Flying pots in the Cerapter fight now give 90 health instead of 60
[*] Flying pots are now 2x bigger so they are easier to spot from a distance and easier to hit
[/list]
[i]Instead of giving the Cerapter one big nerf, I'd much prefer to make gradual nerfs and see if it needs to be nerfed even further. After all, the Cerapter is intended to be a superboss, so I'd rather it be too difficult instead of too easy. If you still find the Cerapter overwhelmingly difficult, please let me know.[/i]

- Solomon

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.6
notes.content:
Hello folks! I was away for the holiday, but I have returned with gifts:

[h2]Reworks / Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Playtime setting to always show[/b] - Playtime will now display during cutscenes and scenes in the real world if set to always show.
[*] [b]Added coyote time for wall jumping[/b] - I noticed a lot of players having trouble with wall jumping sections due to how rigid the timing can feel. You can now wall jump within a split second window after falling off the wall.
[*] [b]Achroma Wyvern charge attack[/b] - The wyvern homes in on you until reaching a set short distance from you. This distance has been increased, so the timing to dodge this attack is more forgiving.
[*] [b]Achroma Hex burst attack[/b] - The Hex's AoE attack has a hitbox that lingers for 0.5 seconds. This didn't feel natural given how the attack looks like an instant burst, so this has been decreased to 0.1 seconds.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with the "Hold F to Skip" hint text not appearing during cutscenes
[*] Fixed bug where you could die immediately after reloading from last save if you died from spikes
[*] Fixed issues with Achroma Hex's 3D UI and flames rendering behind the Achroma Hex
[*] Fixed bug where you could perform a normal jump in midair immediately after a Blink
[/list]

- Solomon

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.5
notes.content:
Not a whole lot to this one!

[list]
[*] Per recommendation of the creator for the game's Speedrun.com page, a [b]setting to show playtime outside the inventory has been added[/b]. It is optimal to apply this setting from the title screen, otherwise you'll lose a couple seconds changing the setting mid-run.
[*] After watching some playthroughs, I noticed the large open room between the World Tree and the courtyard of the Achroma Temple is notorious for deleting player's HP, leaving none for the battle against the 2 Marauders over water. [b]A red crystal health pickup was added to the temple's front yard to alleviate that.[/b]
[*] Small grammatical fix in the true ending dialogue.
[/list]

- Solomon

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.4 Aspect Ratio Fix
notes.content:
If you were playing on monitors with an aspect ratio with a width wider than 16:9, this could result in portions of the menus being cut off vertically.

My sincerest apologies for those affected by this bug--the GUI's have all been reworked to scale accordingly to other aspect ratios.

[b]Please note[/b]: The game is optimized for 16:9, so other aspect ratios may have noticeable black margins on the edges of the screen. This is normal.

Also, the max FOV setting is now 110 instead of 90.

-Solomon

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1.3
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The bug where you could unlock the Cyclical achievement early by dying and collecting Lightning Flux or Tempest Step multiple times is now fixed.
[/list]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] By request, an FOV setting has been added.
[*] Added labels to values in the Settings menu.
[/list]

- Solomon
